Both things are true. And somehow we've ended up in a moment where you have to prove both at once.

What I'm actually looking forward to is the day we stop asking whether someone uses AI and just assume everyone does the same way we stopped asking if someone uses Google. The differentiator was never the tool. It was always the judgment behind it.
